services.title: NASA GIBS: satellite imagery
services.description: Daily and historical satellite imagery of the whole Earth (MODIS, VIIRS, Landsat and more) from NASA's Global Imagery Browse Services, in tiles that line up with the globe's own.

services.title: NASA GIBS: satellite imagery (Web Mercator)
services.description: The same imagery in Web Mercator tiles, as web maps use. Nothing within 5° of the poles.

services.title: basemap.at (Austria)
services.description: The official base map of Austria: streets, buildings, terrain and aerial photographs, from the Austrian federal states and partners. Open Government Data, CC BY 4.0.

services.title: swisstopo (Switzerland)
services.description: Maps and aerial photographs of Switzerland from the Federal Office of Topography and other federal offices. Free under fair use; for bulk data the terms ask for the download service instead.

services.title: PDOK: BRT background map (Netherlands)
services.description: The Dutch government's topographic background map (BRT-Achtergrondkaart) from the Kadaster, in several styles. CC BY 4.0.

services.title: EMODnet Bathymetry
services.description: Depths of the European seas and the oceans from the European Marine Observation and Data Network. CC BY 4.0. Not for navigation.

services.title: USGS The National Map: topographic
services.description: Topographic maps of the United States from the US Geological Survey. Public domain.
